asset_location_code.description: ERP-configured location/site code for the asset.

asset_reference.description: The ERP's own asset number (the natural key users quote).

asset_subclass_code.description: ERP asset subclass code; a narrower class dimension.

blocked.description: The two status flags the ERP carries on the asset.

component_of.description: Link from a significant component to its parent asset.

custodian_employee_reference.description: The employee the asset is assigned to, as the ERP records it.

display_name.description: The asset's name/title as recorded in the ERP.

external_id.description: Stable identity of the source asset record (BC record id, cast to text).

jurisdiction.description: Which measurement base and retention rule apply to this register.

last_modified_at.description: When the ERP last changed the asset record; the harvest delta cursor and the retention clock's reference point.

legal_entity.description: The company/legal entity the asset belongs to, where the connection is multi-company.

revalued_amount.description: Revalued carrying amount, where the revaluation model applies.

serial_number.description: Manufacturer serial number; the reconciliation key between the financial register and the operational plant register.
